policy: This file is a research concordance, not a DSS transcription. Passage ranges are inventory-reported coverage and do not imply that every word in the cited range is extant. Preliminary inventory data must be checked against published editions and current institutional catalogues before textual comparison.

The frg. 55 ii+57–59 line map records only displayed lines 9–13, 18–25 and 30–32; separate manuscript parallels are not incorporated into the 4Q27 transcription. The frg. 60–64 map includes displayed lines 2–12, 15–21 and 25–31 only; line 1 is a dash and other omitted lines are not assigned passage coverage. Unreadable signs and editorial marks are preserved; these fragments are not assigned to scriptural verses by conjecture. The final displayed entry under frg. 109 attributes the visible line to 4Q481d frg. 2,2, not 4Q27; it is not counted as a 4Q27 reading.

sources.use: PAM photographic inventory associations and passage coverage notes for 4Q26, 4Q27, 4Q47 and 4Q53. More specific inventory references for 4Q53 Sam c include 43.071 and 43.077, which cite Ulrich, BASOR 235 (1979), p. 5.
sources.limitation: The fascicle itself describes its lists as preliminary and warns that errors and updates are possible.

sources.title: Dead Sea Scrolls catalogue dataset
sources.institution: West Semitic Research Project, University of Southern California
sources.use: Catalogue identifiers and cross-references for 4Q26, 4Q27, 4Q31, 4Q36, 4Q47 and 4Q53.
sources.limitation: Catalogue records do not by themselves provide a full transcription or exact verse-by-verse state of preservation.

sources.title: Leon Levy Dead Sea Scrolls Digital Library
sources.use: Current institutional manuscript catalogue and image access.
sources.limitation: IAA imaging-plate fragment numbering must not be conflated with DJD fragment numbering without a direct concordance.

sources.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls Study Edition, 2nd edition
sources.institution: Florentino García Martínez and Eibert J. C. Tigchelaar, Brill
sources.use: 4Q47 (4QJoshᵃ) entry: editor and DJD XIV reference, PAM and ROC identifiers, and fragment-to-passage table.
sources.limitation: The editors state that their Study Edition does not replace the DJD editio princeps; the original DJD plates, transcription and commentary remain the basis for detailed work.
